raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Summary

Each data-parallel replica now gets a separate HTTP port when the embedded Rust server is enabled. Previously the listener used `attn_dp_rank`, which is zero on every replica when attention data parallelism is off, so `--dp-size 2` made both servers try port 30000 and left port 30001 unavailable.

The fix uses `dp_rank`, which already holds the replica number. With attention data parallelism, the controller stores the computed attention rank in that same field, so the ports added by #33105 do not change; the existing `dp_size > 1` check also keeps single-replica and externally assigned ports unchanged.

## Reproduction

```bash
SGLANG_RUST_SERVER=1 sglang serve \
  --model-path meta-llama/Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct \
  --dp-size 2

curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:30000/health
curl --fail http://127.0.0.1:30001/health
```

Before the fix, the second scheduler reports that port 30000 is already in use and nothing listens on port 30001. After the fix, both health requests succeed.

cc @rainj-me @sherlockwu

detail.title: [rust-server] fix rust dp listener port

files.patch:
@@ -402,7 +402,7 @@ def launch(cls, scheduler: Scheduler) -> RustServer:
 
         # Per-DP-rank HTTP port with client load balancing. `None` when DP is off,
         # so the rank is not conflated with rank 0 of a one-rank group.
-        dp_rank = scheduler.ps.attn_dp_rank if scheduler.ps.dp_size > 1 else None
+        dp_rank = scheduler.ps.dp_rank if scheduler.ps.dp_size > 1 else None
         if dp_rank is not None:
             http_addr = f"{get_serving().host}:{server_args.port + dp_rank}"

@@ -8,9 +8,11 @@
 from sglang.test.kits.eval_accuracy_kit import GSM8KMixin
 from sglang.test.test_utils import (
     DEFAULT_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST,
+    DEFAULT_SMALL_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST,
     DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
     DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST,
     CustomTestCase,
+    is_rust_server_built,
     popen_launch_server,
 )
 
@@ -67,5 +69,32 @@ def test_get_memory_pool_size(self):
         assert response.status_code == 200
 
 
+@unittest.skipUnless(
+    is_rust_server_built(),
+    "embedded rust server extension not built",
+)
+class TestRustDataParallelism(CustomTestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.base_url = DEFAULT_URL_FOR_TEST
+        cls.process = popen_launch_server(
+            DEFAULT_SMALL_MODEL_NAME_FOR_TEST,
+            cls.base_url,
+            timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_FOR_SERVER_LAUNCH,
+            env={"SGLANG_RUST_SERVER": "1"},
+            other_args=["--dp", 2],
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls):
+        kill_process_tree(cls.process.pid)
+
+    def test_nonzero_dp_rank_has_http_listener(self):
+        # popen_launch_server already waits for rank 0's listener.
+        host, port = self.base_url.rsplit(":", 1)
+        response = requests.get(f"{host}:{int(port) + 1}/health", timeout=30)
+        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.text)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
